title: Kenyan-Style Jazzy Fritters with Peanut Butter Sauce
description: Crispy Kenyan-inspired fritters filled with a sweet and crunchy jazz apple filling, served with a creamy peanut butter dipping sauce, perfect for a Chinese-inspired dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a mixing bowl, combine the jazz apple filling and kenyan flour.
Using a spoon, scoop small amounts of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
For the peanut butter sauce, mix the peanut butter and melted butter in a bowl.
Serve the fritters with the peanut butter sauce for dipping.
Enjoy your crispy Kenyan-style jazzy fritters with peanut butter sauce!
